title: Joe Oliver, Butsy Douglas and Punch Miller in Pensacola
summary: She remembers Joe Oliver coming but did not play with him; her first band was Butsy Douglas's.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: No, I didn't play with him but I remember when he came there. Now I played with another band that belonged in Pensacola, that was Butsy Douglas. What's his name? Butsy Douglas. Butsy. I played with him the first time I played, he was the first band I played with before I got with P.T. and them. His piano played with six, Helen Jackson her name was. And she asked me would I go and play in her place that night. But I only played maybe one night with them.
Yeah. How about Punch Miller, excuse me. Punch Miller, do you remember Punch coming there?
